title: Avatar: Seven Havens Producers Confirm More of Korra & Asami’s Future in Season 2
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens ‘ final episodes have dropped some major teases about Korra and Asami’s future together after the events of The Legend of Korra , and the producers of it all have confirmed that even more of that backstory will be revealed in the coming season and beyond. The Legend of Korra ‘s ending is still sparking all sorts of debates among fans even years later , but it seems like Avatar: Seven Havens is steering straight into all of this as it’s begun to address Korra’s time as the Avatar directly.

Avatar: Seven Havens began with the tease that Korra led to the destruction of the world , and the final episodes of its first season began to show more of Korra’s future after her series with teases that she and Asami actually had a happy future together. But as franchise co-creator Michael DiMartino and executive producer Sehaj Sethi teased to IGN, fans will start to see more of Korra and Asami’s future and potentially what led to the destruction of the world beginning with the second season.

Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 to Share More of Korra & Asami’s Future

“Asami is definitely dead by our show, which I think is a fair thing to say, ” Avatar: Seven Havens executive producer Sehaj Sethi stated about the brief look at Korra and Asami in the first season. Then the producer teased we’ll see more of them in the coming season, “The main thing to know from that is that there is most likely a time jump. But as to their relationship, you do learn more about that in Season 2.” Teasing that this look at them is years after The Legend of Korra , that means there’s even more of a gap to fill in for their future.

Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise co-creator then further confirmed we’ll see more of them soon with, “…we will see more of what Korra and Asami’s relationship was like in the past.” With this look at their future coming years after The Legend of Korra , it was also teased that the two of them had been married after they were last seen on screen. But importantly when Pavi and Nisha see Korra destroying the world with the cataclysm, she’s no longer wearing that betrothal necklace. So there’s quite a lot left there to reveal.

What Does This Mean for Korra and Asami’s Future?

Though it’s now been confirmed that Asami has since died as of Avatar: Seven Havens , it’s yet to be revealed exactly at what point she died. The series takes place hundreds of years after The Legend of Korra , and we don’t know exactly how long Korra had survived before eventually Pavi and Nisha were born as the next Avatar. It could have been some time since Asami’s death that Korra finally passed on, but either way it leads to a huge gap in time that has been left unaccounted for with this new series.

Avatar: Seven Havens has confirmed that it will only be running for four seasons as that’s all that the producers have planned for this new era of the animated series. It seems like the path forward laid out by the end of the first season is that as Pavi learns more about her latent chakras and visits the other six Havens, she’ll also start to form a deeper connection with Korra and the past. It’ll mean that fans can see even more of Korra and Asami’s mystery future, but what do you think about it all? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: SaGa Game Series' Localization Director Neil Broadley Dies
content:
In a message written ahead of his death, Broadley stated that his work colleague would post this from him on his behalf should he die. He stated that he had been struggling with cancer and repeated complications from surgeries, chemotherapies, and radiation treatment. Broadley added that he had kept working on his localization work for the SaGa franchise throughout his battle, but he would unfortunately not see the release of his next project. He is survived by his partner of 25 years, Shige, who shared a messge following Broadley's death.

Broadley worked on localization for several games at Square Enix , including Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven , SaGa Frontier: Remastered , SaGa: Emerald Beyond , Final Fantasy XI , Mobius Final Fantasy , and Final Fantasy Dimensions . Square Enix is releasing the Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United remake game for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam on February 16.

title: My Hero Academia Is Getting Its Most Surprising Debut Yet With Cartoon Network
content:
My Hero Academia is gearing up for one of its most surprising debuts yet as it’s set to start its broadcast with Cartoon Network Japan, and that’s likely going to be a wild home for it going forward. My Hero Academia is now in the midst of celebrating the 10th anniversary of its original TV anime debut , and that means there are all sorts of new projects that fans have seen throughout the year thus far. And that’s even more impressive given that the anime actually ended last year.

Cartoon Network Japan has announced that they will now be airing episodes of My Hero Academia ‘s anime, and that’s made for a wild debut for the TV anime series. It’s outside of the realm of the usual Cartoon Network offerings, and that’s even more true considering that it was only available on the late night Toonami block when it was airing on cable in the United States . You can check out the special promo celebrating My Hero Academia ‘s Cartoon Network debut below.

What’s Next for My Hero Academia ?

As My Hero Academia celebrates the anime’s 10th anniversary, it still has a few plans in place for the franchise’s future for the coming months. The anime might have ended its run last year, but the franchise returned for some new releases through the Spring and Summer months. This included a brand new epilogue episode taking place after the end of the TV series, and a new short that took place even further than that. But there’s still a few more events fans can look forward to coming in the new few months.

My Hero Academia Ultra Expo has been announced as a special new event meant to cap off the 10th anniversary celebration . Taking place in Japan next Spring, this new event will gather members of the TV anime’s voice cast as they celebrate how far it’s all come in the past decade. With this new event, fans are hoping something more for the future is announced too as it still seems like there’s one final story that could be told with Deku and the others exploring their future as pro heroes only briefly seen in the TV anime’s original finale.

My Hero Academia Needs One Final Movie to Really End

My Hero Academia ended its story with a look at how Izuku Midoriya and the other pro heroes looked in the future, and fans are still hoping to see more from it someday. Given the franchise’s past of releasing new feature films in between each new season of the TV series, there was a glaring absence of a potential final movie project with an original story before the finale. But with the TV series now over, there’s a clear runway for the franchise to come back with one final movie project exploring a final original story .

Deku and the others are active as pro heroes in the future, and it really seems like that would be fertile ground to explore with a potential story with one final villain or some kind of event that would help fans say a proper goodbye to it all . But if this really is the end of the long running anime franchise, ten years is nothing to scoff at. Do you want to see My Hero Academia continue with more? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: K Manga Adds nyalra's Strayboy Overkill Manga
content:
Kodansha 's K MANGA platform announced on Sunday that it has added the Strayboy Overkill manga from Needy Girl Overdose (known as Needy Streamer Overload in English on Steam ) writer nyalra as a simpub.

The manga centers on Hinako, a government worker who works for social services. She is a devoted fan of the streamer Hōjun Amama Pink-chan (Amapi for short), who has gone missing. When Hinako goes to a house for a social service call, she finds a boy who looks exactly like Amapi. Together with him, Hinako falls deeper into the abyss of the internet.

nyalra debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Good! Afternoon magazine on April 7. Though the manga's description does not explicitly state that the manga is connected to Needy Streamer Overload , the manga's title implies the connection. nyalra is credited for the original concept, Needy Streamer Overload character designer Ohisashiburi is credited for original character designs, Sōzō Adamuno is credited for the story, and Ōuchi is drawing the art.

nyalra wrote WSS (Why So Serious) Playground and Xemono's Needy Girl Overdose ( Needy Streamer Overload in English on Steam ) game. WSS playground and Xemono released the game simultaneously in English, Japanese, Chinese, and Korean on PC via Steam in January 2022, with the title Needy Streamer Overload in English, and Needy Girl Overdose in Japanese. The game has over 3 million downloads. The game is also available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5.

The game inspired a television anime . The anime premiered on April 4. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired, and it also streamed an English dub .

title: Fan-Favorite Anime Confirms Season 3 Return After 3 Years With First Trailer – Watch
content:
A fan-favorite anime series has now confirmed it’s finally set to make its return for its third season after a three year wait, and has dropped a new trailer to help celebrate. Norio Sakurai’s The Dangers in My Heart originally made its debut in 2018 , and has since become one of the standout romantic comedy anime releases of the modern era thanks to two successful seasons launched thus far. But now the anime is finally coming back for a third round of episodes in the near future.

The Dangers in My Heart wrapped up its second season back in 2024 , and has finally revealed it’s coming back with a third season in 2027. Following the release of a compilation film getting the franchise all sorts of new attention, this next wave of episodes has finally set a Spring 2027 window for its launch. You can check out the first look at The Dangers in My Heart Season 3 below teasing what’s next for its main duo.

The Dangers in My Heart Season 3 Confirms Spring 2027 Release

The Dangers in My Heart Season 2 is currently scheduled for a release sometime next April as part of the Spring 2027 anime schedule, but international release platforms have yet to be confirmed as of this time. It will feature a returning production staff and cast as seen with the previous seasons too with Hiroaki Akagi serving as chief director for Shin-Ei Animation with Dali Chen serving as director, Jukki Hanada providing the scripts for the season, Masato Katsumata providing the character designs, and Kensuke Ushio composing the music.

The voice cast is set to return for The Dangers in My Heart Season 3 too with Shun Horie as Kyotaro Ichikawa, Hina Yomiya as Anna Yamada, Ayaka Asai as Chihiro Kobayashi, Megumi Han as Moeko Sekine, Atsumi Tanezaki as Serina Yoshida, Nobuhiko Okamoto as Sho Adachi, Gen Sato as Kenta Kanzaki, Jun Fukushima as Riki Ota, Aki Toyosaki as Honoka Hara, Yukari Tamura as Kana Ichikawa, Momoka Terazawa as Akira Momoyama, Nobunaga Shimazaki as Haruya Nanjo, Jun Fukuyama as the Imaginary Kyotaro, Yuka Iguchi as Kanna Ando, and Reina Ueda as Yurina Hanazawa.

How to Catch Up With The Dangers in My Heart Before Season 3

If you wanted to catch up with everything that has happened before The Dangers in My Heart ‘s third season makes its debut, there’s plenty of time to do so. You can find the first two seasons now streaming exclusively with HIDIVE with both Japanese and English language audio options available. And you’re going to see why the series has been such a standout release among romantic comedy fans in the last few years since the anime’s launch and takeover too.

The Dangers in My Heart is the usual set up where an introverted boy comes across an extroverted girl, but the twist is that Kyotaro believes himself to be a dark figure who wants his classmates to go into some terrible predicaments. But after meeting Yamada, his whole thing is thrown upside down. With a third season on the way, it’s going to get even bigger so are you excited for this anime’s return? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Powerpuff Girls Creator Reveals Reboot Pitch Was Rejected Ahead of New Movie Revival
content:
The creator behind the massively popular The Powerpuff Girls franchise has revealed that his take on a reboot has fallen through despite a new movie revival now being in the works with Warner Bros. Animation. The Powerpuff Girls has had a strange trajectory over the last few decades as with the original series coming to an end over 20 years ago, fans have seen attempts to bring it back with new reboots or adaptations that have notoriously failed for one reason or another .

One common denominator for each of these failures, however, was the fact that original creator Craig McCracken was not involved in either of those attempts. Things seemed to change back in 2022 when it was revealed that McCracken had signed a deal to develop a new version of The Powerpuff Girls for Warner Bros. Animation , but in speaking on the Makin’ Toons podcast , McCracken reveals that his reboot has since fallen through as it couldn’t settle on what kind of form it would take.

The Powerpuff Girls Reboot From Original Creator Was Rejected

When it was originally revealed that McCracken had signed a deal to develop a new version of The Powerpuff Girls and Foster’s Home for Imaginary Friends , fans had been concerned over the past few years as only the new version of Foster’s seemed to be moving forward . But now that’s been confirmed by McCracken to be the case as a new Powerpuff Girls just didn’t work out, “A few years ago I signed a deal with Warner Bros. to develop a Powerpuff thing and a Foster’s thing. The Foster’s thing went, the Powerpuff didn’t.” As McCracken explained, it was because demands kept changing.

McCracken noted how shifting changes in streaming services and what they wanted in particular meant that a new version of The Powerpuff Girls was harder to put together, “At the time it was like, ‘What’s a serialized version of Powerpuff that’s long form that we could sell to a place like Netflix?’ Okay, they’re not looking for that anymore. ‘What’s a movie? Do you have a movie?’ Now they’re looking for movies. Okay, they’re not looking for movies anymore, so it just keeps shifting.” But that raises questions about what’s next.

What Does This Mean for the New Powerpuff Girls Movie?

It was revealed earlier this year during the Annecy International Animation Film Festival 2026 that Warner Bros. Animation was developing a new Powerpuff Girls movie , but it was unclear as to whether or not the film was actually being greenlit at the time. It was also not revealed whether or not McCracken would be involved with the new project, and these comments about the failed reboot’s production make it seem like McCracken might not be involved with this new feature film version either.

Both the 2010s reboot series and failed live-action adaptation attempts fell through without McCracken’s involvement , and it could end up being the same case here if this movie moves forward without one of the original minds behind the project overall. There’s also no guarantee this happens either with all of the shake ups now happening as a result of the Skydance merger, so we’ll have to see what’s next for The Powerpuff Girls .

What are you hoping to see from The Powerpuff Girls ‘ future? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

HT – Makin’ Toons

title: Deadline: Noah Of The Blood Sea Manga Gets Hollywood Live-Action Film Adaptation
content:
Tyrus Pictures' Michael Zelman and Hamid Mokhneche are producing. The studio is optioning the film adaptation rights from Takeshobo .

In addition, Deadline reported that the original manga is getting an English release in North America. The manga is also getting a release in Taiwan.

The manga's story centers on a luxury cruise ship where the passengers mysteriously die due to vampires.

Satomi debuted the manga on Takeshobo 's Web Comic Gamma website in August 2018, and ended it in June 2021. Takeshobo published the manga's fifth and final compiled book volume in June 2021.

title: Shonen Jump Gets Ready to End More Manga With 3 New Titles Revealed for 2026
content:
Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine is gearing up to end even more of its series (or cancel them) as three new titles have been revealed to be on their way to the magazine through the rest of the year. It’s been a stronger year for Shonen Jump than last year as by this time last year, there had been around ten or so series cancelled . But this year it’s been much fewer with longer running titles coming to their respective ends instead. Though it’s time to get ready to clear up more space.

Shonen Jump has revealed that one of their long running titles is readying to release its final chapter next week after five years of serialization with Kenta Shinohara’s Witch Watch coming to an end. But Shueisha has also announced three new titles that will be kicking off their serialization through the end of the year, and they include some returning creators behind hits like Mission: Yozakura Family among them. So it’s time to get ready for more endings soon.

title: Netflix Locks Down January 2027 Release for New Anime – Watch the Trailer
content:
2027 has been stacking up to be a huge new year for anime , and Netflix is making things even more enticing as they have locked down a January 2027 launch for a cool new anime series coming our way. Although the Fall 2026 anime schedule has been firing off on all cylinders with each of its new releases thus far, fans can’t help but look forward to all of the new releases coming to screens next year. And one of these new hits is coming exclusively to Netflix.

Keigo Shinzo’s Hirayasumi has been a pretty neat manga to see unfold ever since it made its original debut with Shogakukan’s Weekly Big Comic Spirits magazine in 2021 , and now it’s finally going to get an official anime adaptation after six years. Coming our way next January as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule, it’s now been announced that the new series will be exclusively streaming with Netflix outside of its release in Japan. You can check it out in action below.

Hirayasumi Anime Confirms January 2027 Release With Netflix

Hirayasumi will be making its debut sometime next January as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule , but has yet to confirm a concrete release date as of this time. The series will be exclusively be streaming its episodes with Netflix outside of Japan, and this newly revealed update has confirmed that Gen Hoshino will be providing the opening theme. No title for it has been revealed as of this time, but TOMOO has been confirmed to provide the ending theme titled “Fumi Zekka.” It’s all steadily coming together too with the reveal of its voice cast and production staff.

Kei Suezawa will be writing and directing the series for Production +h and Shogakukan with Naoyuki Asano providing the character designs, Mika Nishimura serving as art director, and Kaori Sawada composing the music. The extended voice cast for the anime includes the likes of Yuma Uchida as Hiroto Ikuta, Mayu Takahashi as Natsumi Kobayashi, Rikako Aikawa as Hanae Wada, Daisuke Namikawa as Hideki Noguchi, Yoko Hikasa as Yomogi Tachibana, Yume Miyamoto as Akari Yokoyama, Yuichiro Umehara as Ryo Ishikawa, and Yuko Naito as the narrator.

What to Know About Hirayasumi

Hirayasumi isn’t the most explosive series you’ll dive into, but that’s also what makes it truly stand out from the rest of the pack. The series introduces Hiroto, a young man on the cusp of turning 30 with no real direction in his life. But he wants it that way as he’s spending all of his time just living day to day and enjoying his free time. Bonding with an older woman, the two of them become such good friends that she leaves her house to him after her passing. When his cousin moves in while she goes to school, Hiroto’s life begins to change in unexpected ways.

It’s a slice of life series where it’s all just about these characters living out their lives in peace and without much drama, and that makes it a compelling read. If the anime can tap into that same energy when it hits next year, it’s going to be a big hit. What are you hoping to see from Hirayasumi ‘s anime debut? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Manga Up! Global Adds Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky, Underdog Idol, 3 More Manga
content:
Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service added five manga titles in English over the past 10 days:

Get ready for a chaotic and comedic newlywed life packed with hilarious mishaps between an eccentric noble bride and a rigid, straight-laced marquis!

Alsrod, the protagonist, had trained hard to receive Spellsword as his profession in his bestowal ceremony. However, the profession bestowed upon him was...

“Oda Nobunaga.”

A name so mysterious, no one was sure if it even was a profession.

However, it was the strongest, most overpowered profession which completely changed his fate!
